Uncertainty around apparel size and fit is a huge source of friction for online shoppers, leading to fewer conversions and higher return rates. This undermines shopper confidence in brands, and hurts retailer profits. With roots in Germany, where the average return rate for online retail can exceed 60%, we knew about the severity of the fit and size problem from the beginning.

Our initial solution used a webcam-based body modeling technology which allowed users to create a personalized fit profile using a CD as a dimensional reference object. The technology itself was strong, but over time we noticed that it was too complicated to ensure high user engagement.

This realization inspired the shift to AI technology, fuelling our flagship Fit Finder product and the underlying Fit Analytics data platform. As our machine learning algorithms began generating accurate size recommendations, many retailers saw the immense value in our technology and integrated Fit Finder to solve sizing related issues for shoppers.

For e-commerce operators dealing in apparel and accessories, returns due to size selection failures are a challenge that directly impacts profits. According to the Narvar Consumer Report (https://corp.narvar.com/resources/consumer-report), the number one reason for e-commerce returns is size mismatch, accounting for 42% of all returns.

In this article, we will explain how to develop size guides on product pages to resolve size-related anxiety and simultaneously achieve a reduction in return rates and an improvement in CVR (conversion rate).
The Impact of Size Guides on CVR and Return Rates

On product pages with insufficient size information, customers who are hesitant about their purchase will simply leave. Conversely, when size information is comprehensive, customers can feel confident that a particular size will fit, which increases the rate at which items are added to the cart.

According to analysis by Fit Analytics Case Studies (https://www.fitanalytics.com/), e-commerce sites that introduced size recommendation features reported an average 14.6% increase in CVR and a 32% decrease in size-related returns.
Developing a size guide is a measure you can start in-house without needing to introduce expensive AI tools.
